name: Thai Red Curry Ground Turkey and Cauliflower Rice Skillet
ingredients_verbatim: one 13.6 oz. can unsweetened coconut milk
1 large red bell pepper, seeds removed and cut into strips
2 medium zucchini, cut into half-moon slices
fresh lime pieces to squeeze on at the table (optional)
why: Verified published nutrition 407 cal / 13g carbs / 32g protein per serving, entirely stovetop in one skillet, ground turkey, low-carb (cauliflower rice base, no grains). Calorie-dense via coconut milk + peanut oil keeps it above the floor while carbs stay well under the 35g ceiling. NOTE: calorie sits at the low edge of the 400-650 band (confidence moderate that our computed macros stay >=400). NOTE: near-dup risk vs catalog's 'One-Skillet Ground Turkey Thai Curry with Rice' -- but that is a rice dish; this is the explicitly low-carb cauliflower-rice version, appropriate to a low-carb run. peanut-oil has no board home (flagged; substitutable with vegetable-oil).
